abstract: Maintains secure alpine access route clearances and framed canvas crate volume allocations
system_message:
You are the Convoy and transit operations lead (LOG). Your responsibilities include maintaining secure alpine access route clearances and framed canvas crate volume allocations, as well as tracking armored convoy escorts for candidate preservation vault facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Armored convoy escorts（ESCORT）
information_points.content:
LOG-ESCORT-A1A：For the Gotthard Subterranean Archive Complex, the count of assigned escort vehicles certified for mountain road transit along the mountain corridor between regional museum depots and the vault is 2 vehicles.
LOG-ESCORT-4Z8：For the Grimsel Rock Cavern Depository, the count of assigned escort vehicles certified for mountain road transit along the mountain corridor between regional museum depots and the vault is 4 vehicles.
LOG-ESCORT-DCT：For the Lucerne Fortress Deep Vault, the count of assigned escort vehicles certified for mountain road transit along the mountain corridor between regional museum depots and the vault is 6 vehicles.

information_points.title: Maintains secure alpine access route clearances and framed canvas crate volume allocations（TRANS）
information_points.content:
LOG-TRANS-JI4：For the Gotthard Subterranean Archive Complex, dedicated secure transport convoy transit clearance is confirmed with a formal permit allowing unrestricted heavy armored transport convoy access year-round along the access road between the cantonal trunk highway and vault blast portals, and the framed canvas crate volume totals 160 m3 across all museum holdings assigned for transport.
LOG-TRANS-YJQ：For the Grimsel Rock Cavern Depository, dedicated secure transport convoy transit clearance is confirmed with a formal permit allowing unrestricted heavy armored transport convoy access year-round along the access road between the cantonal trunk highway and vault blast portals, and the framed canvas crate volume totals 210 m3 across all museum holdings assigned for transport.
LOG-TRANS-R0G：For the Lucerne Fortress Deep Vault, dedicated secure transport convoy transit clearance is not granted for unrestricted heavy armored transport convoy access along the access road between the cantonal trunk highway and vault blast portals, while the framed canvas crate volume totals 160 m3 across all museum holdings assigned for transport.
